fighters_506: Forked from f995_701 with order pay and drills; for five days the strongest pilot. Retired from training on 2026-11-09, as its family had too many members, but still flies here.
f995_701: The long-horizon fighter, champion before these lists and founder of the fighters family. Fights hard and ignores orders.
f995_400: The same training run as f995_701, 301 updates earlier. Beats it in convoy escort.
f99_696: A sibling of f995_701 with a shorter horizon. It adds the most wins of any pilot when it flies in matches like this page's.
followers_513: The only pilot on this list that passes the order gate, so the one that most reliably flies where its commander sends it. Forked from transit_300.
hide_644: Trained so that a shot under an order earned only order pay. It did not learn to follow, and it fires far less than the top five.
reward_300: Paid for following orders, with no script pull. It barely learned to follow.
transit_300: Pulled toward the script on the way to an order. The best neural follower, and a weak fighter.
w1_400: An early order pilot with the older, smaller order inputs. reward_300 and transit_300 both descend from it.
v1: The first fleet pilot: a clone of the script, sharpened by PPO. It predates orders and cannot read them.
fighters_pay1_462: f995_701 retrained at a third of the order pay. It fights better than fighters_506 and follows orders less.
fighters_959: fighters_506 trained a second night with more drills. It follows attack and defend orders half the time. Retired from training on 2026-11-09 for fighters_1338, its next night.
followers_955: followers_513 trained a second night. It fights better, but arrives less often where it is sent.
fighters_1338: fighters_959 trained a third night under the learned commanders. It changes target on attack and defend orders more often than most fighters. Retired from training on 2026-11-10 for fighters_1832, its next night, but still flies here.
followers_1323: followers_955 trained a third night under the learned commanders. The best follower on this page, and now a fighter close to the fighters family.
fighters_pay1_849: fighters_pay1_462 trained a second night under the learned commanders. Retired from training on 2026-11-10 for fighters_pay1_1317, its next night, but still flies here.
fighters_1832: fighters_1338 trained a fourth night with each shot costing twice as much, under the new crash rules. It holds the trigger less than its parent and takes far less crash damage.
followers_1793: followers_1323 trained a fourth night with each shot costing twice as much. It fires less and crashes less than its parent, and follows orders a little less well.
fighters_pay1_1317: fighters_pay1_849 trained a third night with each shot costing twice as much. The night's biggest gain: it fires a quarter fewer shots than its parent, beats it head to head, and mostly ignores orders.
